About me

A strategic thinker at heart - I craft solutions that blend creativity, conversion, and clarity for modern brands.

A strategic thinker at heart - I craft solutions that blend creativity, conversion, and clarity for modern brands.

A strategic thinker at heart - I craft solutions that blend creativity, conversion, and clarity for modern brands.

Started as an Electrical Engineer, discovered design during the pandemic, and transitioned from WordPress to Webflow to UI/UX. Worked with brands like Breakdance, Replo App & Carver Bank-where I saw how good design fuels real growth.

Now I lead SquidX Agency as the COO-ensuring every project runs smoothly and delivers measurable growth through strategy, design, and smart execution.
